about: A save from before TM93 to TM148, converted when the game loads it: a scratch copy of Paolo's route29-official.sav (the oldest layout the game reads, before the DNA Splicers), given TM94, TM101, TM126 and TM51 by savedit --tm, which writes into that save what its time had -- hg-engine's TR85 (Work Up), its TM179 (Smack Down) and its TM170 (Steel Beam), and HeartGold's TM51 -- in its 101-slot TM case. Loaded, the bag has New Gold's TM094, TM101 and TM126 and TM51, and none of hg-engine's: TR85, the TM170 item (no machine now) and TM24 (the TM126 item read as hg-engine's Thunderbolt would have made it) are not there. The game saves it, in the layout of now; that save, loaded again by hand, held the same four (4d36732aa): no scenario reloads it, since one starting from it would be a chain leg, which NEWGOLD_PLAYTHROUGH=0 leaves out.
